## Why
Every Claude Stop reads and parses the whole transcript. The cost grows with multi-day sessions, on every turn, for every agent. Backlog item: B028.

## Evidence
origin/main `0ff8887e5e`, verified.

- `summarizeClaudeHookStop` calls `readTranscriptSummary` (`CLI/c11.swift` near 17340).
- `readTranscriptSummary` at `:17366` loads the entire file with `Data(contentsOf:)`, makes a `String`, and splits every line before it walks them for the last assistant message.
- Upstream cmux #5202 reads a bounded tail.
- Research: Fable cluster C9, wave 1. The journal (C11-273, C11-274) must not multiply this. A Stop hook that already reads the whole file gets worse if the journal adds another full read.

## Scope
In: the Stop summary reads a bounded tail of the transcript, enough to find the last assistant message, and does not load a multi-day JSONL into one `String`. If the tail has no assistant message, keep today's fallback to the session record.

Out:
- Journal append, fold, and replay (C11-273). Coordinate so phase 1 does not add a second full-file read on Stop.
- Widening Claude hooks (C11-274). That ticket owns new observation. This one owns the existing Stop read.
- The wrapper exec loop when two bundle paths are on `PATH` (B064). Tier-2 sweep. `Resources/bin/claude`, not this function.
- Hook routing fallbacks and attention-edge cases. Not this ticket.
- Sparkle packaging that rode along in the upstream PR. Ignore it.

## Approach
Read from the end of the file, a fixed byte cap, and parse only those lines. If a line is split at the cap, drop the partial first line. Keep the summary shape `summarizeClaudeHookStop` already returns. Do not spawn another process to do the read. The CLI is already the process.

## Acceptance criteria
1. A fixture transcript of a few megabytes, with the last assistant message near the end, still produces the same subtitle and body the Stop hook produces today.
2. A fixture whose only assistant message is older than the tail falls back to the session record, and the read does not allocate a string the size of the file. A test can cap the bytes read.
3. A missing transcript still takes the existing fallback. Stop does not fail the hook.

## Validation
A CLI logic test with temp files. No host app. No tagged build required unless you want one Stop against a real Claude session. No soak. No source-grep test. Do not build on Hyperion.

## Dependencies
None inside ws:bugs. Neighbors: C11-273 and C11-274. Do not link this ticket behind the journal. It should land first so the journal does not copy the full read. Cross-workstream: the journal ids are J2 and J3. The lead links them if a real code dependency appears. F1 is C11-216 only if you do a tagged check.

## Risks
A tail so short that the last message is always missed, so every Stop says the generic "session completed." Pick a cap that covers a normal assistant message and test a long one. Doctrine: the CLI reads the transcript the hook already receives. No new writes to `~/.claude`. No new strings. Public repo: a bounded file read, not a transcript dump.

Size: S. Tier: P1. Doctrine check: read less of a file the hook already opens. No tenant config writes.
data.title: Bound the Claude Stop hook so it does not reread the whole transcript

Observed local checks: git diff --check passed; plutil parsed project.pbxproj; Python fixture AST parsed. These are syntax/structure checks, not runtime test results. No builds, test suites, or DEV app launches ran on Hyperion.

Draft PR: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/500

Observed evidence
- Exact-head GitHub CI passed: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/actions/runs/36964297692
- Build job passed: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/actions/runs/36964297692/job/110704632002. Its Logic tests (gate) log confirms all 12 ClaudeStopTranscriptTests passed with zero failures, including actual multi-megabyte temp-file reads and the injected offset/length cap checks; the logic suite reports TEST SUCCEEDED.
- All other non-skipped PR checks passed: workflow guards, remote daemon tests, web typecheck, Python syntax, mailbox unit, macOS compatibility, and GhosttyKit. Drawbridge checks were skipped for the draft PR; this is not independent review.
- Local git diff --check, project.pbxproj parsing, and Python fixture AST parsing passed. No build or test suite ran on Hyperion.

The Stop summary now reads at most 256 KiB, drops a partial leading record before UTF-8 decoding, and keeps current normalization/truncation and fallback precedence. The Stop call site and readTranscriptSummary signature are preserved. No send/mailbox/SocketClient changes. Project memberships are ten hand-added lines approved by the Orchestrator.

Validator scenario (batch runtime proof, B028)
1. On Atlas, build a tagged merged-main batch that includes this PR. Record the merged main SHA, this ticket's commit ancestry, tag, and exact built CLI path. Expected: use that batch's CLI, never an operator production binary. No GUI path is required by this CLI ticket.
2. In that batch checkout run C11_CLI_BIN='<absolute built batch CLI>' python3 tests/test_claude_stop_bounded_transcript.py. Expected: exit 0, five PASS lines, and fixture server shutdown. The script creates its own temporary Unix socket/state/transcript and removes inherited c11 identity and options; no live app or real conversation is used.
3. The first fixture writes more than four MiB of user records and a final assistant record. Expected: Stop emits subtitle 'Completed in synthetic-project', body 'Finished synthetic fixture', and persists those same values to its temporary session record.
4. The second fixture places its only assistant record older than the final 256 KiB. Expected: subtitle 'Completed'; body 'Claude session completed in synthetic-project. Last: saved body'. This distinguishes the bounded reader from the former whole-file implementation.
5. The third fixture puts a 200,000-character assistant record inside the cap. Expected: project completion subtitle and a body of 119 'z' characters plus an ellipsis, matching the existing 120-character truncation.
6. The fourth fixture uses a 300,000-character assistant record. Expected: the partial oversized record is discarded and the same session fallback as step 4 is emitted and persisted.
7. The fifth fixture deletes the transcript before Stop. Expected: Stop exits successfully with the same fallback as step 4. Record the command, all five PASS lines, and the batch SHA on C11-306; fix any failure forward on this ticket.

Runtime status: this executable fixture and a real-session Stop have not run. Per the revised go-owner.md Validation flow and the Orchestrator's Atin-approved instruction, C11-306 is low risk and runtime proof is deferred to the Atlas Validator batch; it is not a pre-merge gate. No GUI validation or soak is needed. Independent review, merge, and release remain unperformed. PR stays draft for the Merge Captain.

None.

## Non-blocking

None.

## Review evidence

Reviewed the complete five-file diff, ticket, plan, fence, validation event ev_01M3XEEPVS4FAQMDENJMYWSRME, repository policies, and unchanged Stop dispatch, parsing, normalization, session-store, notification, socket-resolution and fixture-environment seams.

- Sources/ClaudeStopTranscript.swift:13-65 performs one bounded tail request, capped at 256 KiB in production, and closes the file on every outcome. It removes the leading partial record before UTF-8 decoding. Parsing and intermediate allocations are bounded by the tail, including oversized and malformed final records. Invalid UTF-8 and read failures preserve the planned fallback behavior.
- Sources/ClaudeStopTranscript.swift:68-116 preserves string/text-block extraction, normalization, 120-character summary truncation, final body truncation, and fallback precedence. Nil cwd, empty-but-present cwd, and empty lastBody with nonempty lastSubtitle retain their previous distinctions.
- CLI/c11.swift changes are confined to the authorized summary functions. The readTranscriptSummary signature, Stop call site, send/mailbox code and SocketClient are unchanged. Existing strings move without adding new UI copy or tenant-configuration writes.
- GhosttyTabs.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj adds exactly ten membership lines: the helper in app and CLI, and behavioral tests in c11LogicTests. Target/source-phase references resolve correctly.
- The 12 Swift tests exercise actual files, bounded read requests and observable summary results. The Python fixture invokes an explicitly selected executable, uses temporary synthetic state and sockets, scrubs inherited c11 identity/options, and asserts both notification payloads and persisted summaries.

Independently checked GitHub CI run 36964297692 at this exact head: success. Build-job 110704632002 logs show all 12 ClaudeStopTranscriptTests passed, zero failures, and the logic gate reports TEST SUCCEEDED. Other non-skipped PR checks are successful; Drawbridge is skipped for the draft. No builds or tests were run by this reviewer on Hyperion. The remote head and merge-base were refreshed immediately before this verdict and remain as stated above.

## Runtime proof still required

The recorded seven-step Validator scenario is sufficient in combination with the passing bounded-read logic tests. On Atlas, build a tagged merged-main batch containing this change, record its SHA, ancestry, tag and exact CLI path, and run:

```sh
C11_CLI_BIN='<absolute built batch CLI>' python3 tests/test_claude_stop_bounded_transcript.py
```

Require exit 0, all five PASS lines and fixture-server shutdown. The scenarios check a multi-megabyte transcript's final assistant summary, fallback when the only assistant is older than the cap, 200,000-character truncation, 300,000-character oversized-record fallback, and missing-file fallback. Each checks emitted and saved subtitle/body. The older-assistant scenario would fail with the old whole-file reader, so it proves the packaged CLI is wired to the bounded behavior; byte-cap evidence comes from the Swift tests and production read seam.

Executable runtime proof and a real-session Stop remain unperformed. Under the explicit Atin-approved batch policy, executable proof is deferred to the Validator and is not a pre-merge gate. No GUI run or soak is required for this ticket. This verdict does not assert merge, deployment or observed real-session behavior.
